_comment: Public business identity used by the site (lib/site.ts). Leave a value empty ("") if it is not confirmed; optional sections are omitted automatically. Production builds (SITE_ENV=production) fail if any required value is empty. Never put secrets here. contact_email is a PLACEHOLDER until the domain and mailbox exist. exporter_positioning_approved: the site presents the company as a licensed Ethiopian coffee exporter (licence confirmed by the owner, 26 Sep 2026). Set to true when the owner approves publication (see docs/exporter-positioning-review.md). Production builds fail while it is false.
